arabic text: MAZLOOM BAY WATAAN YEH MERA MOLA RAZA HAI.\nHY JIS KO ZEHAR LOGO MUSALMAN NEY DIYA HAI
english translation text: Oppressed and far from home—this is my Maula Raza.\nPeople, he was poisoned by those who called themselves Muslims.

arabic text:
SAB ANKHEIN KARO BANDH DHUHAYEE HEY
DHUHAYEE
IK BIBI AZADARO YAHAN SHAAM SEH AAYI
LIPTI HAI JANAZAY SAI NAHIN SAAR PAY RIDA HAI.
english translation text:
Close all eyes—alas, alas! O mourners,
a Lady has come here from
Shaam. She clings to the bier,
with no veil upon her head.

arabic text: AIYEH HAIN JANAZAY PAI NABHI SHAH-E-UMAM BHI\nKULSOOM RUQAYA BHI HAY MASOOMA-E-QUM BHI\nWO BIBI HAI KARBAL MAI JALIL JIS KI ABAAAH HAI.
english translation text: The Prophet and the leaders of the Imams have come to the funeral;\nKulthum, Ruqayya and Masooma of Qum are here as well.\nThis is the Lady whose cloak was burned in Karbala.

arabic text:
ROTAY HAIN FARISHTAY BHI ZAMEEN OR ZAMAAN
BHI
HI LOOH KALAM ARSH-E-BAREIN KON-O-MAKAN BHI
KHAIR-UL-NISA KEH LAAL KAI MATAAM KI SADA HAI.
english translation text:
The angels weep, as do the earth and
all time; the Tablet, the Pen, the Mighty
Throne and all creation mourn. The cry of
mourning rises for the son of Khair-un-Nisa.

arabic text: MAMOON ABBASSI KI ANAYAAT HAI YEH LOGO\nHY ALAY PAYAMBER SEY ADAWAAT HAI YA LOGO\nSAYYEDON PEY ZARA DEKHO YA UMAAT KI WAFA HAI.
english translation text: People, this is the ‘favour’ of Mamun Abbasi;\nthis is the hatred shown toward the Prophet’s family.\nLook at the loyalty this nation has shown to the Sayyids.
